mapper.select: SELECT pi.instance_id AS processInstanceId, biz.business_type AS businessType, biz.business_id AS businessId, 'COMPLETED' AS expectedStatus, biz.actual_status AS actualStatus FROM wf_process_instance pi JOIN ( -- HR SELECT process_instance_id, 'HR_RECRUITMENT' AS business_type, id AS business_id, status AS actual_status FROM hr_recruitment_requisition WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'HR_LIFECYCLE', id, status FROM hr_lifecycle_application WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'HR_TIME_REQUEST', id, status FROM hr_time_request WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'HR_OFFER', id, status FROM hr_offer WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'HR_COMP_CHANGE', id, status FROM hr_comp_change WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'HR_PERFORMANCE_OBJECTIVE', id, status FROM hr_performance_objective WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL -- OA UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_EXPENSE_CLAIM', id, status FROM biz_expense_claim WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_PURCHASE_REQUEST', id, status FROM biz_purchase_request WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_PAYMENT_REQUEST', id, status FROM biz_payment_request WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_CONTRACT', id, status FROM oa_contract WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_BUSINESS_TRIP', id, status FROM oa_business_trip WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_BUDGET_PLAN', id, status FROM oa_budget_plan WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT', id, status FROM oa_budget_adjustment WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_PROJECT', id, status FROM oa_project WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_KNOWLEDGE', id, status FROM oa_knowledge_document WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_SEAL_APPLICATION', id, status FROM oa_seal_application WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_LICENSE_BORROW', id, status FROM oa_license_borrow WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'OA_VEHICLE_USAGE', id, status FROM oa_vehicle_usage WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL -- CRM UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'CRM_APPROVAL', id, status FROM crm_approval WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'CRM_QUOTE', id, status FROM crm_quote WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT process_instance_id, 'CRM_RENEWAL', id, status FROM crm_renewal WHERE status IN ('PENDING','APPROVING') AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL ) biz ON pi.instance_id = biz.process_instance_id WHERE pi.status = 'COMPLETED' AND pi.end_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowMinutes} MINUTE)
